about: B1 NC-01 (plan 7.4 rule 16): a function's own F (ownWords: the feed of the M128 compensating moves, the M140 retract, the PLANE and cycle 19 tilting move) is skipped as a whole word. It is not the feed in force, and it does not end a feed set by FZ or FU. An F in front of the function stays the path feed of its block.

states.about: M128 F800: the feed of the compensating moves.
PLANE … MOVE F2000: the feed of the tilting move.
CYCL DEF 19.1 … F1500: the feed of the rotary-axis positioning.
F600 in front of M128 is the path feed of the block; F900 behind it is M128's.
M140 MB MAX F1000: the feed of the retract.
A feed per tooth, by word.
M128 F800 does not end the feed per tooth either.
A PLANE block over two lines: the F on the continued line is still PLANE's.
